title: IPC admin.peers.own_addresses result
description: This node's own addresses for the show screen (ADR-0062 decision 4), one ordered list a client renders as it comes and never filters: every confirmed external address (AutoNAT-verified, kind confirmed_external) in the order it was confirmed; then, only when there is none -- the node is relay-only -- each circuit route through a reservation it holds (kind relay_circuit); then every listen address bound on an interface (kind listen) in bind order. Every row is in the classes the add admits: the configuration's multiaddr-with-peer-id grammar, ending in /p2p/<peer>, and no component in a special-use class of ADR-0052 rule 2 (private ranges admitted), the floor applied by the transport. At most 64 rows; past them the rest is dropped in that order and `truncated` says so. The QR's 16-line cut is the client's. Params: the empty object.
